hypothesis: After physical channel removal, readapting learned PHM consumer bases may improve held-out output reconstruction and repaired classification beyond preserving the bases. Reinitialization probes dependence on the learned starting span. This hypothesis and the procedure are not established novelty or a demonstrated gain.
scope: One CE-selected PHM parent, seed2026, two independent local fitting sites (blocks0/8), fixed n=rank=4, one 50% internal-group removal fraction. The combined compressed model changes only these two hidden widths, not all nine sites; reported full-model savings must reflect this. Six local fits, three compressed repairs, two uncompressed further-training controls and one full-budget compact scratch reference; no automatic extension.
selection: Deterministic magnitude ranking of the actual effective producer kernel after BN folding, summed over the four component channels of each internal group; ties by index. Masks fixed from the trained parent and shared by all methods. Independent source-parent activations at each site; no sequential target refitting or calibration/validation-based mask tuning.
initialization: Producer and consumer cores are physically sliced, keeping PHM partition/component order. Preserve and adapt share exactly the same sliced starting state. Reinitialize uses one seeded random orthonormal four-dimensional basis span in R16, with least-squares cores projecting the same sliced effective kernel into that span. It changes starting function; initial errors and losses are reported, not hidden. This is a learned-PHM initialization control, not a Hamilton-versus-random-algebra experiment.
fitting: Local pre-BN consumer-output reconstruction: full-batch normalized MSE via exact uncentered activation moments, float64 CPU Adam,300 attempted steps per condition, same learning rate; best finite fit-only checkpoint including step0. Preserve freezes the consumer basis; adapt/reinitialize train its basis and cores.500 fit images are even calibration indices;500 separate check images are odd indices. Check metrics are diagnostic only, never select starts/steps/masks. Local float32 artifacts are replayed on both moment packs.
repair_scope: All ordinary surviving weights, BN affine parameters and PHM cores can train. All PHM bases are frozen except the TWO chosen conv2 bases in adapt/reinitialize. Preserve stores the same coefficients but trains128fewer reals. Both uncompressed controls start from the unchanged selected parent and follow the same preserve/adapt flags,3epochs and paired streams; no local fitting on the uncompressed controls. BN statistics update under the same recipe. Epoch3 is the final repair endpoint; no checkpoint or hyperparameter selection on check/validation.
scratch_scope: One full200epoch scratch model has the exact compact physical hidden widths but randomly initializes all ordinary parameters and learns all18PHM bases using the original baseline recipe/seed. It is a full-training-budget reference, not an equal-update repair control; report CE-selected and final validation separately. Same train/validation split, no official test. It does not inherit the parent weights, basis tensors or pruned channel identities beyond chosen widths.
evaluation: 48000 training images,1000 validation,500 fit,500 check; verify disjointness and exact coverage. No official-test predictions. Record before/after validation CE/accuracy, held-out local MSE, actual stored/trainable reals, buffers, model bytes, optimizer attempts/successes, factor changes and effective-kernel changes. Raw basis-coordinate distance is not an invariant scientific measure because PHM factorization has change-of-basis freedom. Local error does not guarantee whole-network ordering.
decision: Primary comparison is adapt versus preserve after identical3epoch repair. Continue-to-replication only if mean per-block held-out relative MSE reduction is>=2%, neither block worsens by>1%, validation accuracy improves>=0.5pp, compressed CE decreases, and the compressed CE improvement is at least the uncompressed further-training CE improvement. Also report a local-only-signal flag independently. Thresholds are practical pilot gates, not significance tests. Retain every failed/negative outcome. Scratch comparison provides budget/context, not a claimed matched-update effect. No automatic next dataset/seeds/allocation run.
resume: Immutable protocol/config/source/input hashes; moment and local-fit artifacts hash-checked. Local Adam checkpoints every25steps and on STOP; repair/scratch checkpoints per completed epoch with optimizer/scaler/RNG. STOP at output pauses local steps or training batches; interrupted partial training epochs repeat. No recipe change or result deletion to bypass a failed check.
